Package com.im.njams.sdk.utils

Class ExceptionSupport

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.utils.ExceptionSupport
  • public class ExceptionSupport
extends Object
    Plain utility without any dependencies on SDK state for running code whose exceptions shall be ignored. Suppressed exceptions are logged at debug level only. Clients may use it as well.
    Since:
    6.1.0

    • Method Detail

      • optionalOf

        public static <T> Optional<T> optionalOf​(ExceptionSupport.ThrowingSupplier<T> supplier)
        Wraps a supplier that may throw an exception into an Optional. If the supplier throws an exception, it is logged at debug level and an empty Optional is returned.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The type of the value supplied.
        Parameters:
        supplier - The supplier to wrap.
        Returns:
        An Optional containing the value supplied by the supplier, or empty if an exception was thrown.

      • suppressException

        public static void suppressException​(Runnable runnable)
        Runs a Runnable and suppresses any exceptions thrown, logging them at debug level.
        Parameters:
        runnable - The Runnable to run.

      • suppressException

        public static <T> T suppressException​(Callable<T> callable)
        Runs a Callable and suppresses any exceptions thrown, logging them at debug level.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The type of the value returned by the Callable.
        Parameters:
        callable - The Callable to run.
        Returns:
        The value returned by the Callable, or null if an exception was thrown.
